questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Interchanged : × and +, 9 and 6

Check all options one by one.

Option 1) 7 × 6 ÷ 3 + 9 - 8 = 17

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 7 + 3 × 6 - 8 = 17

⇒ 7 + 18 - 8 = 17

⇒ 25 - 8 = 17

⇒ 17 = 17 (Correct)

Option 2) 6 × 8 - 9 ÷ 3 + 5 = 50

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 9 + 8 - 6 ÷ 3 × 5 = 50

⇒ 9 + 8 - 2 × 5 = 50

⇒ 9 + 8 - 10 = 50

⇒ 17 - 10 = 50

⇒ 7 ≠ 50 (Incorrect)

Option 3) 7 + 6 × 4 ÷ 9 - 8 = 8

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 7 × 9 + 4 ÷ 6 - 8 = 8

⇒ 7 × 9 + 0.6 - 8 = 8

⇒ 63 + 0.6 - 8 = 8

⇒ 63.6 - 8 = 8

⇒ 55.6 ≠ 8 (Incorrect)

Option 4) 9 × 7 + 4 ÷ 1 - 6 = 7

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 6 + 7 × 4 ÷ 1 - 9 = 7 

⇒ 6 + 7 × 4 - 9 = 7

⇒ 6 + 28 - 9 = 7

⇒ 34 - 9 = 7

⇒ 25 ≠ 7 (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 7,68,400 votes. If 82,560 votes were declared invalid and 20% people did NOT cast their vote, then the invalid votes were what percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) of the votes which people did NOT cast?
questions.questionHtml: In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 7,68,400 votes. If 82,560 votes were declared invalid and 20% people did NOT cast their vote, then the invalid votes were what percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) of the votes which people did NOT cast?
questions.solution:
Percentage of total valid votes that winning candidate secured = (100 - 42) = 58%

% difference b/w the winning and defeated candidate = 58 - 42 = 16%

So, the total number of valid votes = 768400 ÷ 16% = 4802500

Total number of votes (both valid and invalid) = 4802500 + 82560 = 4885060

Total number of voters = 4885060 ÷ (100 - 20)% = 6106325

Number of people who didn't case vote = 6106325 × 20% = 1221265

Now, % = (82560/1221265) × 100% = 6.7602% ≈ 6.8%

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation. Every time boss comes up with some good idea, he gets into ___________.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation.

Every time boss comes up with some good idea, he gets into ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is trouble.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word that completes the collocation is 'trouble'.
  • 'Get into trouble' is a phrase that means to encounter a problematic situation or state of hardship.
    • Example: I've gotten in trouble, Dave. Is there any way you could lend me some money?
  • ​Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation is option 1.


Correct Sentence: Every time boss comes up with some good idea, he gets into trouble.

Additional Information

  • Fun: pleasure and enjoyment; an activity or a person that gives you pleasure and enjoyment. (मौज-मस्‍ती)
  • Sleep: the natural condition of rest when your eyes are closed and your mind and body are not active or conscious. (निद्रा)
  • Shock: the feeling that you get when something unpleasant happens suddenly; the situation that causes this feeling. (एकाएक अप्रिय घटना घट जाने से उत्‍पन्‍न मनःस्थिति, झटका, आघात, सदमा, धक्‍का; इस मनःस्थिति को उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाली परिस्थिति)

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. Neither the doctors nor / the nurse were present / when the patient / reached the hospital.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Neither the doctors nor / the nurse were present / when the patient / reached the hospital.
questions.solution: 'Was' should be used instead of' were'. If a sentence has two subjects connected by or/nor, either/or, or neither/nor, the verb must agree with the second subject (the subject closer to the verb). Correct Sentence: Neither the doctors nor / the nurse was present / when the patient / reached the hospital.

Key Points

  • Mutate: to change into a new form. (नवीन रूप धारण करना, परिवर्तित होना)
  • Change: to become different or to make somebody/something different. (बदलना, परिवर्तन करना)
  • Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank is option 3. 

Additional Information

  • Replicate: to copy something exactly. (किसी वस्‍तु की प्रतिकृति या हूबहू नक़ल करना या बनाना)
  • Imitate: to copy the behaviour of somebody/something. (किसी के आचरण की नक़ल करना; अनुकरण करना)
  • Incise: mark or decorate (an object or surface) with a cut or cuts. (उत्कीर्ण करना; काटना)

questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. As a boy Elon was a keen reader and learnt how to code computers.

Q. He even made his own video game called Blastar.

R. Later he moved to Canada and then the United States setting up his first company with his brother Kimbal in 1995.

S. But after some time, he sold that company to create a company called X.com.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: PQRS. The paragraph follows a chronological sequence of Elon Musk's life. It begins with his childhood interests in reading and coding (P), followed by a specific achievement from that time, creating a video game (Q). It then moves to his young adulthood, relocating and starting his first company (R), and concludes with the subsequent business move of selling that company to start X.com (S).

The first step in tattooing is to develop an artistic (4) _______ and the skill to sketch and create your artwork. Tattooing penmanship is far more (5) _______ than sketching on paper.

  • Fertilising: gerund or present participle of fertilise; to put a male seed into an egg, a plant or a female animal so that a baby, fruit or a young animal starts to develop. (गर्भाधान करना; शुक्राणु या पुष्‍प-पराग प्रदान करना)
